1. A system for flight control of an electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) aircraft, the system comprising:a pilot control connected to an eVTOL aircraft, wherein the pilot control is configured to transmit a pilot instruction of a pilot;
a pusher component connected to the eVTOL aircraft;
a lift component connected to the eVTOL aircraft; and
a flight controller communicatively connected to the pilot control, wherein the flight controller is configured to:
estimate a stall speed for the eVTOL aircraft as a function ;
receive the pilot instruction from the pilot control;
initiate operation of the pusher component as a function of the pilot instruction;
terminate operation of the lift component as a function of the pilot instruction; and
transmit a warning to the pilot as a function of the pilot instruction and the stall speed.
2. The system of claim 1, wherein the pilot instruction comprises at least information on a pilot's desired transition from substantially vertical flight of the eVTOL aircraft to substantially horizontal flight of the eVTOL aircraft.
3. The system of claim 1, wherein the pilot control comprises at least one of a control switch and a control lever.
4. The system of claim 1, wherein the pusher component comprises at least a propulsor.
5. The system of claim 1, wherein the pusher component is configured to generate a generally forward thrust for the eVTOL aircraft.

7. The system of claim 1, wherein the lift component is configured to generate a generally upward thrust for the eVTOL aircraft.
8. The system of claim 1, wherein the flight controller comprises a computing device.
